scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install
scripts.build:proto: npm run build:proto:ts && npm run build:proto:go
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm run build && node ../scripts/build-extensions.mjs
scripts.build: npm run prepare && npm run build:proto && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:client:test && npm run lint && npm run test:server && npm run test:go && npm run test:integration && npm run test:website
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:browser:install && node --test --test-concurrency=1 server/tests/*.integration.cjs && go test -race -tags=integration -count=1 -timeout=5m -v ./tests/integration
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rm -rf server/node_modules node_modules
scripts.test:browser:install: puppeteer browsers install chrome && node --input-type=module -e "import {access, constants} from 'node:fs/promises'; import {executablePath} from 'puppeteer'; await access(await executablePath(), constants.X_OK)"
scripts.lint: go vet ./client/... && bash -n scripts/install.sh && bash -n scripts/bundle-linux-libs.sh
scripts.preview:website: npm run build:website && wrangler pages dev dist/website --port 8787
scripts.deploy:website: npm run build:website && wrangler pages deploy dist/website --project-name termium
